language.script_notes: Chilean Spanish as national — this is the country's demographic and cultural core.
false_friends: coastal Peru/Ecuador (similar Pacific climate in parts)

road_furniture.curb_style: As national; dense formal urban infrastructure in Santiago.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: As national; extensive vineyard/farm road network through the Central Valley.

architecture.roof_style: Pitched roofs on French-influenced 19th-century wine estate buildings; modern high-rise architecture in Santiago's business district; colourful corrugated-metal hillside houses in Valparaíso.
architecture.roof_material: Varied — tile on formal estate buildings, corrugated metal on Valparaíso's hillside houses.
architecture.wall_construction: French-inspired stone/stucco wine estate architecture throughout the Central Valley (Maipo, Rapel, Maule); modern glass-and-concrete Santiago skyline; brightly painted, densely packed hillside houses in Valparaíso's historic port.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Elegant cream/stone tones on wine estates; a famously colourful, jumbled palette of paint on Valparaíso's steep hillside houses.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: French-style 19th-century wine estates (Concha y Toro, Santa Rita) alongside modern gravity-fed winery architecture; Santiago's modern skyline framed by the Andes; Valparaíso's UNESCO-listed colourful hillside cityscape with funicular lifts.

nature.vegetation: Mediterranean climate supports extensive vineyards and farmland across the Central Valley, running roughly 400km north-south between the Andes and the Pacific; the Andes rise dramatically to the east of Santiago, often snow-capped.
nature.terrain: A fertile valley squeezed between the Coastal Range and the high Andes, with Santiago sitting in a basin often visibly hazy/smoggy against the mountain backdrop.
nature.climate_signature: Mediterranean — dry, sunny summers and mild, wetter winters; golden late-summer hillsides and green vineyard rows are a strong regional signature.

vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: As national; heaviest vehicle density given Santiago's population.

google_coverage.camera_generation: Best and most current coverage in the country, concentrated around Santiago and the wine valleys.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: Very dense, near-complete coverage — most 'generic Chile' imagery is actually this region.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shares the Andes as a backdrop, similar wine-valley agriculture and Mediterranean-adjacent climate just across the border
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Chilean plates and yellow-reflector bollards differ from Argentine plates; Chile sits on the wetter Pacific side of the Andes while Mendoza sits on the drier eastern side, giving subtly different vegetation.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same plate/bollard base style
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Central Chile is green vineyard and farmland with a Mediterranean climate; the north is barren desert, and the south is lush temperate rainforest and glaciers — both look nothing like the Central Valley.
